label: Foreknowledge finite omitted-premise and one-two-four representative controls
paraphrase: Finite relational tests: identity alternatives track one Boolean content, universal alternatives fail contingent knowledge, empty alternatives vacuously satisfy completeness without factivity, and constant content permits fixed alternatives. Four-world profiles have exactly one, two and four covering pairwise inequivalent representatives for zero, one and two independent bits. This is a bounded quotient count, not a theory of divine cognition or libertarian agency.
